'''Bandar Tenloss''' was the founder of the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]], one of the largest criminal operations in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] not controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="GG11" />

==Biography==
Bandar Tenloss formed the eponymous [[Tenloss Coalition]], a criminal organization with roots in the [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]] that originally focused on contract kidnapping and occasionally [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. Under its founder it grew into the Tenloss Syndicate, one of the region's largest criminal conspiracies. By approximately [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] it had spread across 64 star systems in the [[Astal sector/Legends|Astal]], [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic]], [[Dail sector/Legends|Dail]], [[Skine sector/Legends|Skine]], and [[Lol sector/Legends|Lol]] sectors, and had an estimated 560,000+ direct and indirect employees.<ref name="GG11" />
